summary: Made main's dashboard smoke tests green again after today's owner commits, restored the stale-stats warning on the new Analytics page, and fixed its 'Over time' card on phones.
why: 6 smoke-test failures on main would have blocked every dashboard branch at the merge check. The other fixes were a regression the rewrite brought back, a misleading 'through yesterday' with no data, a broken phone layout seen in tonight's screenshots, and the flaky test logged this morning.

findings.title: Smoke tests expected the old upload plan
findings.detail: The owner's fallback-settings fix (12:37/19:07, long videos Saturday) made two tests fail; they now follow it.

findings.title: New Analytics page lost the stale-stats warning
findings.detail: Plain 'Through <day>' replaced the amber/red line; its smoke test failed.

findings.title: Over time card broken on phones
findings.detail: The metric switch covered the title and squeezed the description to one word a line.

findings.title: Two load flakes
findings.detail: Settings unsaved-changes bar and Undo on resolve-all each failed once in a full run, 12/12 alone. CI retries once.

changes.title: Smoke tests follow the new fallback settings
Analytics: stale-stats warning back
changes.detail: Coloured 'YouTube Analytics through <day>' in the new freshness line.

changes.title: Analytics: no data reads 'none'
changes.detail: studio.db.ts no longer falls back to yesterday for the freshness date.

changes.title: Smoke test: stat-card heights measured until they settle
changes.detail: Removes this morning's flake without loosening the check.

changes.title: Cards: header actions wrap on phones
changes.detail: Card headers wrap; switches scroll instead of wrapping labels. Smoke test.
